messages.subject: Re: [dartR] Error during PCA
parts:
Hi Laia,

Can you first try:

> install.packages("terra”) 

Then, if the package terra was succesfully installed:

> devtools::install_github("green-striped-gecko/dartR@beta")

If that didn’t work…. R, RStudio and the packages are constantly being updated, and sometimes the updates have some bugs, and the packages don’t work. So, maybe one possible solution would be to update r and RStudio. It is a bit tricky, though, so below is a nice short tutorial about updating them. 

https://www.linkedin.com/pulse/3-methods-update-r-rstudio-windows-mac-woratana-ngarmtrakulchol  

Please let me know if that worked; otherwise, I will be happy to help you further. 

Cheers,
Luis
